ogre_magi_dumb_luck.name: Dumb Luck
ogre_magi_dumb_luck.description: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

ogre_magi_fireblast.name: Fireblast
ogre_magi_fireblast.description: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
ogre_magi_fireblast.lore: Ogres are easily amused—they can spend hours entertaining themselves by playing with fire.
ogre_magi_fireblast.note0: When Multicast triggers, each additional stun is applied with a %multicast_delay% sec. delay.
ogre_magi_fireblast.scepter_description: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.

ogre_magi_ignite.name: Ignite
ogre_magi_ignite.description: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
ogre_magi_ignite.note0: Multicast Bonus: This ability has a chance to affect random enemies within %ignite_multicast_aoe% radius.
ogre_magi_ignite.note1: Reapplying this ability extends the duration of the existing effect.

ogre_magi_bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
ogre_magi_bloodlust.description: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
ogre_magi_bloodlust.lore: Running is boring... Let's fight instead!
ogre_magi_bloodlust.note0: Multicast Bonus: May affect multiple allied units within a %multicast_bloodlust_aoe% radius.

ogre_magi_multicast.name: Multicast
ogre_magi_multicast.description: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every %strength_for_one_pct% Strength adds %one_tooltip%%%.
ogre_magi_multicast.facet_ogre_magi_fat_chance: Each point of Ogre Magi's Strength adds %strength_mult%%% to Ogre Magi's Multicast chance.
ogre_magi_multicast.lore: Ogres may lack brains, but sheer luck is all the skill they need to succeed in battle.
ogre_magi_multicast.note0: Only targeted abilities and items can Multicast.
ogre_magi_multicast.note1: Targeted abilities and items affect additional enemies and neutral creeps within a certain radius of the hero. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast instead hit the same target multiple times.
